name: Lobotomy Chimp
summary: Enter the primal terror of Lobotomy Chimp, a horrifying twist on survival games. Trapped in a shadowy lab, you must evade relentless chimps—twisted experiments gone wrong. Climb, swing, and hide as their brutal instincts hunt you down. Use the environment to survive, but beware: the deeper you go, the darker their secrets. Can you outsmart what’s been unleashed? The hunt begins now.
